description: Browse US residential foreclosure/bank-owned (REO)/short-sale auction listings on xome.com by state (and optional county). Returns property facts (beds/baths/sqft/year built/lot size/occupancy), sale type and auction_status/bid_deadline for every listing on the page — NOT the bid or sale price (call xome_property_detail for that plus the exact sale date and courthouse venue). Sourced from xome.com/auctions/{state}[/{county}].

county.description: Optional county name, e.g. "fresno" or "los angeles" (spaces become dashes automatically)

page.description: Result page, starting at 1 (each page holds ~50-100 listings)

name: xome_search
title: Xome Search
